// Generator of go-oracle.json: the toolset table and version of the Go build.
// The Go code is frozen, so this is kept as text. To regenerate, copy it to
// internal/toolset/zz_oracle_test.go, run
//
//	go test ./internal/toolset -run TestZZOracle -count=1
//
// and delete the copy.
package toolset

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"testing"
)

func TestZZOracle(t *testing.T) {
	lines := []string{}
	for k, v := range entries {
		lines = append(lines, k+"="+v)
	}
	sort.Strings(lines)
	out := map[string]any{
		"recordedFrom": "238e07f66d8cafab24ef363cb79e207bd48babd8",
		"version":      Version(),
		"lines":        lines,
	}
	b, err := json.MarshalIndent(out, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile("testdata/go-oracle.json", append(b, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
